name: roomi-fields
description: Open-source plugins by roomi-fields for Claude Code: RTFM (retrieval layer for any project), NotebookLM (citation-backed Q&A), and osc-bridge (MIDI & OSC bridge for synthesizers and DAWs).

plugins.name: rtfm
plugins.description: The open retrieval layer for AI agents. Indexes code, docs, legal, research, data with FTS5 + optional embeddings. Serves surgical context via MCP. Pure-Python plugin — no pip install required.

plugins.name: notebooklm
plugins.description: Automate Google NotebookLM at scale. Citation-backed Q&A, full Studio generation (audio, video, infographic, report, presentation, data table), multi-account rotation with auto-reauth, and batch_to_vault for offline RTFM-ingestable answer caching.

plugins.name: osc-bridge
plugins.description: Declarative OSC bridge for music hardware and software — 849 synthesizer drivers (MIDI/SysEx) plus DAW & live-coding targets (Ableton, Bitwig, Reaper, Sonic Pi, SuperCollider). A MIDI MCP and OSC MCP: discover the device catalogue, read a device's OSC surface, send OSC to synths and DAWs from Claude.
